darpan.migration.DarpanMigration.description: Seed a default chat space for tenants that have notification settings but no space. Idempotent — tenants that already have any chat space are skipped.
Clear chat space webhooks that can no longer be decrypted after a crypt key change. Idempotent, and a no-op on an installation that never stored a webhook.
Backfill the denormalized companyUserGroupId stamp on rule-set child rows created before the stamp existed. Idempotent no-op on already-stamped rows.
Translate the legacy canReadOrders flag into explicit SourceConfigEndpointAccess rows. Idempotent by PK.

Delete SourceSystemConnectorField pill rows withdrawn from seed data. Seed loads are createOrUpdate and never delete, so withdrawal needs an explicit deletion. Idempotent — a second run deletes nothing.

Fold every automation's run history into its stored clean-day streak, so the clean-run Chat line reads the day count from the first message (DAR-BE-144). Idempotent — a fold reads only slots past the stored cursor.
DAR-BE-334: the old tenant scripts become queries on moqui-jexl and their deployments chat-only schedules, switched off until someone allowed to schedule turns them on. Idempotent (MIG_ ids).

Rebuild each automation's own filter rows from its run's where 3.4.0's AUTOMATION_FILTER_TABLE dropped them (DAR-BE-338: automations run on their own copy again). Sides that have rows are left alone; where the drop never ran nothing is written. Idempotent.
Let an acknowledgement have no note (DAR-UI-152): AuditFindingAcknowledgement.note becomes nullable. Schema only, no row changes. Idempotent: a nullable column is left alone.

Delete the SystemMessageRemote rows (OPENAI_RULE_WORKSPACE, GEMINI_RULE_WORKSPACE, RULE_WORKSPACE_LLM_ACTIVE) the deleted LLM provider settings wrote, an LLM API key among them (DAR-OPS-029 S27). Nothing reads them. The dry run counts them. Idempotent. Ships disabled (a seed load keeps it so): enable it to run it.

Let an agent ledger row have no conversation (OC186: a one-shot writer's spend is the tenant's, with no conversation): AgentTurn.conversationId becomes nullable. Schema only, no row changes. Idempotent: a nullable column is left alone. Until it runs, writer spend fails to record and is logged; nothing else changes. Ships disabled (a seed load keeps it so): dry-run it, then enable and run it.

Widen DarpanSetting.settingValue to VARCHAR(4095), keeping NOT NULL (DAR-OPS-029 S27, OC124'): a STRING setting may hold 2000 characters (errors.email.ignorePatterns ships 1,363) and the column was VARCHAR(255). Schema only. The dry run shows the statement. Idempotent. Ships disabled (a seed load keeps it so): enable it to run it.

Remove what the retired NetSuite RESTlet connection type left (DAR-BE-424): its sharing rows, enumeration and tenant filter row, the NS_RESTLET_CONFIG_ID columns of RULE_SET_COMPARE_SOURCE and RECONCILIATION_AUTOMATION_SOURCE (foreign keys first), the NS_RESTLET_CONFIG table with its __TABLE_BOOTSTRAP__ placeholder, and NS_AUTH_CONFIG.NETSUITE_ACCOUNT. The dry run reports RESTlet configs per tenant, the rule-set, automation and audit-check sides still naming one, and the shares: read it on prod and SM before enabling. Refused while an active rule set or automation names a RESTlet. Does nothing before the release that deletes the entity. Idempotent. Ships disabled (a seed load keeps it so): enable it to run it.

Report only (DAR-OPS-029 S02, the OC6 release check): every enabled rule whose stored ruleLogic the compile gate refuses in production (not the field-comparison generator's exact output, or a validator violation), by tenant and rule set, with rule ids. A refused rule fails its run after the release that carries 913ecf6f: dry-run this on prod and SM before that deploy (darpan-admin migrations dry-run RULE_LOGIC_SHAPE_CHECK). Changes nothing, dry run or not. Ships disabled (a seed load keeps it so).

Drop the tables and columns deleted entities and fields left behind (DAR-OPS-029): RUN_DATA_DOCUMENT, RUN_SYSTEM_INSTANCE, AUTH_SECRET, PASSKEY_SIGN_IN_CHALLENGE.USERNAME_HINT, TENANT_CHAT_SPACE.GOOGLE_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL, SOURCE_SYSTEM_CONNECTOR.EXCHANGE_STATE_LOOKUP_SERVICE_NAME, CONFIG_ID_RESOLVER_SERVICE_NAME and VALIDATION_SERVICE_NAME, SLACK_POSTED_MESSAGE, HOTWAX_OMS_REST_SOURCE_CONFIG.ORDERS_PATH and RETURNS_PAGE_SIZE. Drops only what exists and nothing the entity model still defines or another table references; the chat column waits while any space's only webhook is still in it. The dry run gives each one's row count. Schema only. Idempotent. Ships disabled (a seed load keeps it so): enable it to run it. An orphan added later is one more entry in OrphanSchemaDrops.DROPS; after the release that deletes its entity or field, dry-run this migration and run it again with darpan-admin migrations run ORPHAN_SCHEMA_DROPS --force (a SUCCESS row stops the sweep, not force). Entries still in the model wait, so running it early is safe.
